name: Grade 9 IIIT Practice: October Week 5 - Security Risk
description: Practice words for Grade 9 third-trimester STEM and cybersecurity work.

words.definition: Trying many passwords until one works.
words.example: A brute force attack tried many password combinations until one worked.

words.definition: An attack that overloads a service with too much traffic.
words.example: The DDoS example overloaded a website with too many requests.

words.definition: A tool that helps block unsafe network traffic.
words.example: The firewall blocked the unsafe connection in the scenario.

words.definition: A software change that fixes problems or improves security.
words.example: The update fixed a security weakness in the app.

words.definition: A short situation used for practice.
words.example: The scenario described a student receiving a suspicious login message.

words.definition: A way to reduce risk or harm.
words.example: Two-factor authentication was the protection chosen for the account.
Sharing the class link publicly created a risk for the meeting.
